# Copilot instructions

- Follow the root `AGENTS.md`.
- Use the chosen stack: React with Vite, Express, TypeScript and npm workspaces.
- Keep frontend UI and browser code in `frontend/`; keep HTTP/backend code in
  `backend/`. Keep workspace coordination at the root with one npm lockfile.
- Prefer minimal, conventional solutions and focused changes.
- Run relevant tests, type checks and builds before reporting completion;
  report any checks that could not run.
- Do not add unnecessary infrastructure, abstractions or application features.
- OpenCode specialist agent definitions will be added later. Do not create them
  or custom orchestration infrastructure as part of this scaffold.
